meta.title: Codeissue - From idea to working product
meta.description: Codeissue designs and builds digital products using AI-assisted workflows, custom systems, and human review.

hero.lineOne: Every idea starts as an issue.
hero.lineTwo: We turn yours into a working product.
hero.description: Strategy, design, engineering, and review. One focused team from first note to working release.

ticket.title: Turn an idea into a product

approach.title: Your idea. Our next issue.
approach.description: We design and build digital products using AI-assisted workflows, custom systems, and human review.

principles.title: AI-assisted, not AI-shaped.
principles.copy: We use AI where it improves speed and coverage. Product decisions, taste, and accountability stay human.

principles.title: Built for the actual problem.
principles.copy: No generic stack pasted onto every brief. We shape the system around the product, constraints, and team.

principles.title: Reviewed before release.
principles.copy: Every important interaction, edge case, and implementation choice gets a deliberate human pass.

approach.label: Working agreement / 03

process.title: One team from first decision to release.
process.description: The same people stay with the problem. Scope, interface, code, and review move in one visible thread.

steps.title: Frame the issue.
steps.copy: We turn the idea into a precise problem, define the audience, and agree on what a useful first release must do.

steps.title: Design the system.
steps.copy: We map the experience, prototype the difficult parts, and create a visual system that supports the product instead of decorating it.

steps.title: Build the product.
steps.copy: Design and engineering move together. We implement the core, connect the systems, and keep the release usable at every checkpoint.

steps.title: Review and release.
steps.copy: We test real scenarios, resolve edge cases, document the handoff, and ship a release that can keep evolving.

services.title: Products, systems, and the work between them.
services.description: We build focused launch surfaces, customer products, operational tools, and the foundations that keep them reliable.

items.title: Web products
items.copy: Customer-facing platforms, dashboards, services, and responsive interfaces.

items.title: Internal systems
items.copy: Tools and workflows that remove repetitive work and make operations easier to understand.

items.title: AI-assisted features
items.copy: Useful AI inside a product - scoped, tested, observable, and always reviewable.

items.title: Product foundations
items.copy: Design systems, architecture, prototypes, and the groundwork for a reliable next release.

network.title: The work is public where it helps.
network.description: Source code, build notes, demos, community feedback, and direct updates across the channels you already use.

socials.discord: Community, feedback, and the fastest way to reach us.
socials.github: Source code, experiments, and work in progress.
socials.telegram: Compact updates, launches, and useful links.
socials.youtube: Build logs, product demos, and longer explanations.
socials.x: Short notes, links, and work shared in public.
socials.instagram: Visual fragments from design and development.
socials.tiktok: Short product, code, and internet-native videos.
socials.twitch: Live sessions with the process left visible.
socials.max: A direct channel for updates and announcements.

cta.title: Have an idea worth shipping?
cta.description: Send the rough version. We will help turn it into a clear next step.

footer.note: AI-assisted workflows. Custom systems. Human review.

auth.title: Sign in to your workspace.
auth.description: Use your username and password. Email is not required.
auth.security: Protected by Auth.js and server-side access control.
auth.sideTitle: One workspace for every incoming issue.
auth.sideDescription: Requests, orders, integrations, and delivery events stay in one operational view.

overview.title: Everything that needs attention, in one place.
overview.description: A working foundation for orders, cross-channel conversations, integrations, and backend telemetry.

inbox.title: Messages from every channel. One queue.
inbox.description: Normalize Discord, Telegram, email, social, and custom API messages into a single conversation model.
inbox.empty: No conversations match the current filter.
inbox.systemMessage: Conversation normalized and ready for an operator.

orders.title: From first request to shipped product.
orders.description: Track scope, owners, status, value, and the conversation that created each order.

integrations.title: Connect channels without coupling the product to them.
integrations.description: Each source is represented by a stable adapter, normalized events, and an auditable delivery log.
integrations.secretHint: Secrets are read from environment variables and never exposed to the browser.

events.title: Listen to WebSocket and API traffic.
events.description: Inspect normalized backend events in real time, reconnect safely, and review persisted deliveries.
events.wsMissing: A short-lived backend ticket is requested when you connect.
events.apiReady: Protected API polling and the authenticated backend proxy are enabled.

common.demoData: Demo data is shown until PostgreSQL is available.

register.title: Start with a username, not an inbox.
register.description: Create an account without email. You can open a product issue immediately after registration.
register.usernameHint: 3-32 characters: latin letters, numbers, hyphen, or underscore.
register.haveAccount: Already have an account? Sign in

errors.invalid_display_name: Enter a display name between 2 and 80 characters.
errors.invalid_password: Use a password with at least 12 characters.
errors.unknown: Account could not be created. Try again.

newIssue.title: Describe the product you want to move forward.
newIssue.description: No email form and no generic brief. Give us the problem, the desired result, and the channel where you want to continue the conversation.
